|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Finalizer (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2022-06-11.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates given below are the documented PC image-repository revision dates (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2022-06-01-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022) → [[File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2022-06-01-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-D-finalizer_ai-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026: the later card-size copies of this image are no longer listed as separate versions; see the version list.)
* '''Original''' ([[Finalizer (ALT)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 10 August 2021<ref name="img-altpng-25e5dad-finalizeraipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc commit 25e5dad] (10 August 2021) (“Virtual AI pack series 2”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/finalizer_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Executor”. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, and 4 [First Order] starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
